findings.summary: The saved list shows a blank screen when the user has no saved shops.
The button says “Save” after the shop is saved. “Saved” is clearer.
findings.reason: The approved design (R4) uses “Save” with a filled icon, as iOS does.

findings.summary: The session token is in localStorage, so any script on the page can read it.
Email import needs read access to each user’s Gmail. Google’s review of that access takes weeks.
Pasted HTML keeps inline styles. Strip them before the tag parser runs.
